name: GREATEC
recent: Greatech 近期公告几乎全部是 EPF 作为大股东连续申报持股变动，同时一名董事也申报了持股变动。新闻方面，公司位于美国的新厂房（价值 7960 万美元）已投入运作，订单创下 4.5 亿美元新高；此外，马股大型科技股受波及。
notable: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间几乎每个交易日都申报持股变动。
董事 Dato' Seri Tan Eng Kee 于 10 月 16 日申报持股变动。
公司美国新厂房（7960 万美元）投入运作，订单创 4.5 亿美元新高。
risks: EPF 连续多个交易日申报持股变动，显示大股东持股持续调整。
马股 20 大科技股市值蒸发 44.6 亿令吉。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 2.096 亿令吉，环比增长 17.1%，但同比下滑 9.9%；净利为 3358 万令吉，环比增长 24.8%，同比增长 29.5%；净利率为 16.0%，高于上一季度的 15.0%。

recent_en: Greatech's recent announcements are almost entirely continuous shareholding change filings by EPF as a substantial shareholder, along with a director's interest change.
notable_en: EPF filed shareholding change notices almost every trading day from October to November.
Director Dato' Seri Tan Eng Kee filed a shareholding change notice on 16 October.
The company's new US plant (US$79.6m) is operational, with order book at a record US$450m.
risks_en: EPF's consecutive daily shareholding change filings indicate ongoing adjustments by a substantial shareholder.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR209.6m, up 17.1% QoQ but down 9.9% YoY; net income was MYR33.58m, up 24.8% QoQ and 29.5% YoY; net margin was 16.0% versus 15.0% in the prior quarter.
